newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil closes lower, 3rd mth breaks 1,250.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil closes lower, 3rd mth breaks 1,250.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Technical selling and long liquidation pulled down prices at close after June futures broke 1,250 support level. An Egyptian offtake did not aid the market which is expected to come down further if soyoil falls tonight. Speculation of higher output in March also weakened market. June support - 1230/resistance - 1250.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Fell in widespread deal on futures drop.
Lower soyoil prices overnight and uncertainity in the fundamental outlook had triggered selling earlier.
A chartist said that June futures contract could be heading for its next support level of 1,230 ringgit, now that 1,250 was broken.
Despite Egypt's offtake, market players were mostly bearish about the near-term trend. "Egypt only bought 10,000 tonnes," said a trader.
The June futures contract closed 16 ringgit down at 1,240 ringgit ($499.19) a tonne.
Traders said Egypt bought 10,000 tonnes of palm oil from FELDA at $565 a tonne for May delivery on Wednesday.
Turnover on the futurews market stood at 1,402 lots.
Physicals April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,287.50 ringgit against bids of 1,282.50, after trading from 1,292.50 to 1,287.50.
April (central) saw offers at 1,275 and bids at 1,270.
May (south) was offered at 1,280 and bids at 1,270, and May (central) at 1,270 against 1,265.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $542.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May at $540, June at $537.50 and July/Aug/Sep at $532.50.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $577.50, May at $575, Jun at $567.50 and July/Aug/Sep at $565. April was traded from $580 to $576.50, and May from $577.50 to $572.50.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $437.50 and Apr/May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $292.50.
